canonical_journey.input: The exact active v3 allocation, one exact schema-v4 Plan 125 successor reservation with a selection-pending tracker, the revised Plan 125 graph, and the two named operator documentation surfaces.
canonical_journey.action: Park the v3 allocation, allocate and select the v4 contract on the exact planned successor claim, then update and execute the documented exact-revision start path.
